title: Insert Bits Into Bit Range
description: You are given two 32-bit signed integers `n` and `m`, and two bit positions `i` and `j` (`0 <= i <= j <= 31`, 0-indexed from the least significant bit). Clear bits `i` through `j` (inclusive) in the 32-bit two's complement representation of `n`, and replace them with the lowest `j - i + 1` bits of `m`. Return the resulting 32-bit signed integer.
hints: Be careful with shift widths when `j - i + 1 == 32`, since shifting a 32-bit integer by `32` wraps modulo 32 in Java.
Build the width mask in 64-bit arithmetic as `low = (1L << (j - i + 1)) - 1L`, clear `(low << i)` in `n`, and OR in `((m & low) << i)` before truncating to a signed 32-bit integer.

examples.explanation: Clearing bits 0..3 of -1 (all 1s) and inserting 0 gives ...11110000 = -16.
Replacing the entire 32-bit range 0..31 with -1 returns -1.
